objective: Make skipped verification impossible to ship silently, and make contract-bound source coupling visible at edit time. Two outages in two days share one cause: a Markdown-only change to a digest-bound operating-contract source was delivered without running pnpm verify, which runs contract:compile and checks exactly that binding. Commit 52b0c41 records the first, where the Founder runtime would not start; the remote-control delivery reproduced it. Nothing currently verifies a pull request, because the only workflow is a manual graduation-resource job. Add a provider-side pre-flight that runs the environment-independent portion of the verification suite on every pull request and on push to main, with read-only permissions and no secrets. Add a repository-owned Claude Code PreToolUse guard that reads the bound source list from config/iris-operating-contract.v1.json at runtime and prompts before an edit to any of those files, naming the rebind procedure. The guard must fail open so a malformed input, missing file, or unexpected error never blocks ordinary work. Neither control may weaken any existing permission, deny rule, test, or governance boundary.
issuer: Founder Cristofer Stoic Arellano through Claude
completion_exclusions: No change to branch protection, rulesets, repository or organization settings, or required-check configuration
No secret, variable, token, or credential creation, reading, or reference
No change to the canonical operating contract, its digest-bound sources, config/iris-operating-contract.v1.json, or generated/**
No change to any registry, since docs/registries/technology-and-platform-registry.md is itself a digest-bound contract source
No weakening of any existing allow, ask, or deny permission rule
No dependency addition, removal, or update
No Phase 0 graduation execution, approval, or completion claim
permitted_actions: Add .github/workflows/verify.yml running on pull_request and on push to main, with permissions contents: read, no secrets, a concurrency group that cancels superseded runs, and an explicit timeout

Run in that workflow the environment-independent verification steps: format:check, contract:compile, build, lint, typecheck, and the test suite excluding the two test files that require the sibling Founder Command Center workspace or the GitHub CLI
Record in the workflow and the operations document that the excluded tests keep the workstation pnpm verify as the authoritative full check, so the pre-flight is never mistaken for full verification

Add scripts/hooks/contract-bound-source-guard.mjs, which reads the bound source list from config/iris-operating-contract.v1.json at runtime rather than hardcoding paths, so it stays correct as the contract evolves
Register that script as a PreToolUse hook for Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit in .claude/settings.json, additively, leaving every existing permission rule byte-identical
Emit a permission prompt naming the file, the pinned digest, and the rebind procedure recorded in commit 52b0c41, so the operator makes a conscious decision rather than being blocked
Author an operations document describing both controls, their limits, and how to remove either
prohibited_actions: Block, deny, or hard-fail any tool call from the guard; it must fail open on malformed input, missing configuration, or unexpected error
Hardcode the digest-bound source list in the guard script
Modify, reorder, or remove any existing entry in the allow, ask, or deny arrays of .claude/settings.json
Add any secret, token, credential, environment variable, or third-party action beyond first-party actions/checkout and actions/setup-node
Change branch protection, required checks, rulesets, or any repository or organization setting
Edit any digest-bound contract source, the contract config, or generated output
Force-push, rewrite history, or use broad staging
Claim the pre-flight constitutes full verification or Phase 0 progress

acceptance_commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run --exclude tests/founder-windows-startup.test.ts --exclude tests/iris-dev-github.test.ts

required_evidence: The guard invoked against a digest-bound path returns a prompt decision naming that path, and against an ordinary path returns no decision
The guard fails open on malformed JSON, absent file_path, and missing contract configuration, each demonstrated
A byte-level confirmation that no existing allow, ask, or deny entry in .claude/settings.json changed, and that only an additive hooks key was introduced
The excluded-test rationale, with proof that both excluded files fail identically at clean main in the same environment
Workflow permissions are contents: read, no secrets are referenced, and only first-party actions are used
Focused and full verification results, exact changed paths, limitations, and rollback instructions
